name: LangChain-Unchained
description: 7 Streamlit Implementations of simple LangChain projects

paragraphs: The LangChain Unchained series is a collection of small LangChain projects with a Streamlit UI. Each project demonstrates the implementation of different components of LangChain, a framework for working with large language models.
